evidence_note: Paths identify implementation and acceptance harnesses. Actual executions and their environments are recorded in versioned verification reports. Optional-engine availability is distinct from successful operation/model execution. Core editor/server use the Python standard library; imaging uses a separate pinned runtime.

capabilities.scope: Reduced rational rates 1–60; exact media timestamps and absolute 48 kHz sample grid.
Own multitrack editing, trim/split/ripple delete, slip/slide/outgoing-cut roll, speed/reverse and track controls. No nested sequences, multicam, proxy workflow or optical-flow retiming.

Cut/gap AV exchange with SHA-bound private authoring data. Nested compositor inputs, retained disconnected inputs and title plates are remapped by verified content identity. Mismatched same-ID bytes and incomplete private dependencies cannot restore silently. General nested OTIO/AAF/XML semantics remain unsupported.

One primary clip source plus up to eight independent project video/image sources in a 32-node graph; explicit ranges, signed offsets, transparent/hold behavior and actual ordered merges. No nested/deep/general plugin graph.
Independent channels with five interpolation modes; polygon topology retained, 128 scalar keys or 64 path keys per channel.
No Bezier/feather-point hierarchy, roto paint or general effect-mask ports.
No deep, multiview, arbitrary-channel EXR graph.
Actual FFmpeg correlation; 384-pixel analysis edge, 480 frames and explicit missing matches.
Independent additive translation with up to 128 simplified keys; no automatic crop.
New ellipse with animated measured center, preserving authored channels. Not segmentation.
No affine/projective solve, re-identification or lens/rolling-shutter estimation.
Display-referred Rec.709 timeline grades, RGB curves and scopes measured from actual rendered display RGB. Optional OCIO still-image development remains separate from this SDR movie graph.

Separate OCIO/RAW/bracket still processing and authored Cycles frame sequences preserve scene-linear float EXR masters. Cycles supports premultiplied RGBA beauty and depth/normal/vector/diffuse/emission passes. Movie compositing/delivery remains SDR; no whole-timeline OCIO/ACES management, HDR mastering or calibrated output monitoring.
No general vector document/Bezier drawing, Lottie/SVG interchange or full text animators.
Own WebGL primitive/mesh scene controls, bounded vertex/face edits and live modifiers, materials/camera/lights/keys, actual headless Cycles and retained .blend.
Indexed OBJ/selected MTL import with UVs, normals and material partitions; actual viewport and retained Blender geometry.

Bounded vertex moves, face extrude/delete/subdivide and live Mirror/Bevel/Subdivision exist. Edge tools, UV authoring, sculpting, hierarchy/constraints, rigs, deformation and simulation remain missing.
Bounded PINHOLE/SIMPLE_PINHOLE solved-camera import with exact pose/intrinsics; no feature extraction, SfM, bundle adjustment or dense reconstruction.
Source architecture reviewed; no solver/graph worker or photogrammetry acceptance.
Predictor source reviewed; no actual segmentation worker/checkpoint execution.
Coordinates/state source reviewed; no actual learned tracking worker.
Camera/ray/pose source reviewed; no inference or general faithful camera-conditioning export.

API workflow/input/model preflight validates installed socket types, output indices, ranges and an actual reachable video-saving route. Scoped prompt lifecycle and actual output admission are implemented; configured endpoint was unavailable at the recorded inspection. No successful neural generation claimed.
Decoded waveforms, track/clip gain, balance, fades, retime/reverse and stereo export. No full DAW, buses, plugins or general channel layouts.
Typed recipes, snapshot jobs, owned-process cancellation, receipts and polling recovery. No arbitrary scripting, expression or plugin host.
H.264 MP4 and ProRes MOV with actual render snapshot/source identity. Separate imaging jobs retain float EXR and display PNG. No universal broadcast/cinema/HDR delivery suite.
No full decoded/GPU realtime cache, collaborative database or signed/notarized bundled runtime.
No authenticated Runway/Krea/OpenArt/Magnific/Artlist/Firefly/Flow/Luma/Kling/Pika/FLORA/Weave integration.
Explicit Rec.709/sRGB/linear/LogC3 EI800 decode, Rec.709/Rec.2020/ACEScg/AWG3 primaries and Bradford white adaptation in float RGBA; Rec.709 SDR output.
Project-owned SHA-256 Cube 1D/3D tables, explicit domains, linear/trilinear/tetrahedral interpolation; same rendered frame/export graph. No combined shaper tables.
Data-only fSpy v1/JSON import; preserved calibrated roll, principal offsets and focal scales; explicit world axis/scale and one undoable camera replacement.
Own WebGL and retained Blender camera share vertical FOV, roll, off-axis principal offsets and fx/fy; project/source aspect must agree.
Sensor height/focal length, focus distance, f-stop and aperture shape; bounded physical channels and actual Cycles DOF. No lens prescription design.
Principled transmission, IOR and scene-linear emission, with base color/roughness/metallic. Bounded material controls; no full shader graph.
Actual Cycles max/diffuse/glossy/transmission/transparent bounce counts, denoising and seed in saved scene; no Mitsuba/pbrt renderer or inverse solver.
Validated Brown forward and bounded numerical inverse functions; the separate calibrated-lens node now applies a stricter five-term model to actual footage pixels. No Lensfun profile conversion.
No Optiland/ray-optics optical prescription, sequential/nonsequential trace, glass catalogue, optimization, aberration/PSF/MTF toolchain.
No Mitsuba spectral/polarized/differentiable backend, inverse optimization or pbrt scene transport.
No general lazy scene graph, path/set/context model, asset variations or distributed Gaffer-style dispatch.

Actual rawpy/LibRaw unpack and demosaic for preserved SHA-addressed camera RAW stills; white balance, highlight and half-size controls, float linear EXR and separate OCIO display image. No RAW movie timeline.

Known-response radiance merge of 2–16 aligned static-scene stills with explicit shutter times; float EXR and separate display output. No alignment, ghost removal, response-curve fitting, panorama stitching or colour-hdri runtime.
No DiffusionLight checkpoint/inference/HDR environment generation; reading source is not model integration.

One native application with CINEMATICUM authoring controls and owned local service; verified archive/rollback during replacement. FFmpeg/Blender and the optional stable imaging runtime are separate installed dependencies.
Own Trim dialog previews and applies integer-frame source slip, touching-shot slide and outgoing-cut roll with speed/reverse/source-handle limits, locked-track rejection and one shared undo.

Up to eight independent owned project-media nodes with source in, duration, signed animation offset and transparent/hold endpoints. Preserved trim/split domain, paused/export parity and no implicit source audio mix.

Static five-term Brown footage undistort/redistort with normalized intrinsics, compatible scene-camera copy, premultiplied bilinear RGBA and transparent borders. Whole-image contraction bound q≤0.45; at most two nodes; nonidentity canvas ≤2,073,600 pixels. No fisheye, lens database or automatic calibration.

Own vertex/face selection and move, face extrusion, connected subdivision and face deletion. Canonical authored cage hashes separate original import provenance; 10,000 vertices/faces, 512 selected elements and one undo per evaluated edit. Geometry edits currently clear imported UVs.

Four ordered actual Blender Mirror/Bevel/Subdivision modifiers with parameters, enable/reorder/remove/refresh/apply. Viewport uses actual evaluated mesh; retained .blend preserves cage/stack and independently rejects stale or forged evaluation before rendering.

Actual OpenColorIO builtin-config CPU source-to-scene-linear and display/view transforms with explicit input space and exposure. ACES-capable builtin configs; current display output fixed to sRGB. No arbitrary external config or movie-wide color management.

Single-part RGB/RGBA still input and float32 ZIP EXR output retain negative/superwhite values and explicit premultiplied alpha; output receipt binds config, runtime, source and artifact identity. Separate display PNG enters SDR editing. No deep/multipart/arbitrary-channel movie graph.

Owned polling identity rejects late responses for earlier jobs; interrupted polling exposes Retry status and Cancel. Mesh candidates require current project/revision/object identity before one undoable apply. Recovery does not silently apply abandoned candidates.

Core standard-library server invokes a separate isolated worker. Stable Mac interpreter at ~/Library/Application Support/CINEMATICUM/Imaging/py313-v1/bin/python; NumPy 2.3.5, OpenColorIO 2.6.0, rawpy 0.27.1 and OpenEXR 3.4.15. Runtime and actual engine outputs are checked separately.

Revision-bound per-editor checkpoints, monotonic acknowledgements, explicit recovery with one undo entry and up to 20 previous saves. Current media inventory remains authoritative; failed/corrupt checkpoints are not silently treated as saved.

Streamed ZIP64 export and verified fresh-identity restore of owned edit/media/LUT/workflow/RAW/imaging/scene dependencies; 64 GiB and 10,000 member bounds. No automatic workflow execution or external model/plugin bundling.

Select a shot-list document, review requirements, bind actual video and source ranges, preview takes, persist unresolved plans, assemble exact-frame continuous cuts as one undoable edit, and download shot requirements. Missing/short/off-grid sources prevent assembly; no filler or issuance.

Actual Cycles float32 scene-linear Rec.709 RGBA EXR sequences, premultiplied transparent world and selectable depth/normal/vector/diffuse/emission passes; lossless ZIP and per-file/hash/clock manifest. H.264 review remains display-referred.

Continuous transported aiming for new/imported cameras; legacy world-up framing preserved until explicit change. Complete eased intervals reject undefined camera/target and aimed-light collisions before engine launch. Vertex edits retain UV seams.

All eight EXIF display orientations share bounded FFprobe admission and exactly-once decoding. Deleted/rebound clips release media listeners and audio graph nodes; inactive playback resources are bounded while active layers are preserved.
